summary: Iteration 5 — backend-only retest of the three iteration-4 fixes. Created /app/backend/tests/test_bot_diagnostic_fixes.py (6 new tests) and removed the now-stale xfail marker on test_live_balance_has_rpc_ok in test_bot_diagnostic.py. Full run: 48/48 tests PASS (test_bot_diagnostic_fixes.py 6, test_bot_diagnostic.py 24, test_live_trading.py 9, test_live_rpc_ping.py 9). HIGH fix verified: the 'IMPORTANT: ... auto-execution is NOT wired' reason is present in the default state AND still present after seeding a live_manual_swap trade doc into Mongo (reasons list = 6 items, live_manual_swap_trades counted =1); seed doc deleted and verified 0 remaining. auto_execute note verified: with mongo auto_execute=true the dedicated 'NOTE: mongo_config.auto_execute=true only affects SIMULATED fills' reason appears; after toggling auto_execute=false via Mongo the note disappears while the auto-exec 'not wired' message remains — original value (true) restored and asserted. MINOR fix verified: /api/live/balance unconfigured branch now returns ready:false, wallet_configured:false, reason, sol:0.0, rpc_ok:false, meets_reserve:false. Latency regression: bot_diagnostic best-of-3 < 0.5s (~0.25s), confirming no Solana RPC calls. No _id leakage. All regression endpoints (/api/health, /api/live/status, /api/live/rpc_ping, /api/live/trades, /api/live/summary, POST /api/live/test_swap, /api/stats) behave as before.

Still open from iteration 4 (non-blocking): five duplicated `try/except Exception: value = 0` blocks around count_documents silently coerce Mongo failures to 0, producing a misleadingly clean diagnostic if Mongo is down. Surface a mongo_error field instead.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >1100 lines — split into routers (live/, arb/, diagnostics/).
bot_diagnostic still does `from datetime import timedelta` inside the handler; move to module-level imports.

Time filters use ISO-string $gte comparisons on created_at/timestamp — works only because all inserts store .isoformat(); any future insert of a real datetime object will be silently excluded from counts.
